title: BOWLOUT
description:
Like with "real" bowling, the goal is simple: Hit the Pins! 

BOWLOUT is a singleplayer First-Person-Shooter set in a Pin-infested Bowling centre. Use your many, many Bowling Balls to take them out and destroy their leader in this short but satisfying adventure!

FIRE AWAY! Throw some Bowling Balls... no, I mean LOTS of Bowling Balls!

TOTEMS BEGONE!These unique enemies summon more pins. Break them ASAP! 

FEATURES:• To ball or not to ball: Chucking balls affects accuracy - adjust your playstyle carefully.

• Who you callin' pinhead: Grab pins for powerful melee attacks or a piercing throw. 

• Shower me in medals: Unlock various achievements by playing well... or not so well.

• My eyes are up here: Obtain and equip different ball colors by unlocking achievements.

• A master on the sticks: Use a controller to feel it rumble as you shatter groups of pins.

• All eyes on Deck: While not (yet) verified, BOWLOUT plays great on Steam Deck.

WARNING: Many bowling pins were harmed during the creation of this game!
description_short: Defeat pins with rapid-fire bowling balls or powerful melee strikes to avoid getting guttered in this First-Person PvE Bowling game.
